title: Standard playing deck — 52 faces, joker, back
description: A complete 52-card French-suited deck with at least one named joker and one reversible back design. A card-back-only pack should use its own blueprint.
designerChecklist: All 52 distinct ranks and suits are present, exactly once in the main deck; the joker is visually distinct from every rank.
Agree on a single card aspect ratio (recommended 5:7) and normalized corner radius, border inset and safe area.
Suit and rank identifiers remain readable at phone size; avoid using red/black alone to convey meaning.
Jacks, queens and kings have consistent framing and mirrored layout where appropriate.
Back design is non-directional or explicitly documented as directional; all card backs share dimensions.
Use common style, background bleed, copyright ownership and legible contrast across the entire collection.
Export in approved data-only media (SVG/PNG/WebP/JPEG); check legibility, transparent backgrounds and licensing.
